clips.title: The story
paras: In Hillsbrad Foothills, you gather toxic fungi from an overrun farmstead for Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill. The Mudsnout Blossoms will fuel the Royal Apothecary Society’s experiments, as Lady Sylvanas seeks a plague against the living and the Scourge.

The Scourge ravages the north, while the Alliance clings to towns like Southshore. In Tarren Mill, Apothecary Lydon works under the Dark Lady’s command to develop a plague against both. He finds alchemy tedious, yet gathers potent organic toxins from the countryside to brew elixirs meant to hasten the destruction of Sylvanas’s enemies.

Nethander Stead lies south of Tarren Mill and east of the river. The abandoned human farmstead is overrun by vicious Mudsnout gnolls. Mudsnout Blossoms, foul-smelling mushrooms, grow among its filth and neglected soil. Their concentrated organic poisons are prized by the Royal Apothecary Society. You can cut through the gnoll packs or weave quietly past their ramshackle camps to gather them.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Another day, another elixir to be made. If it were up to me, I'd just let the pathetic humans and Scourge fight it out. They seem bent on killing each other as is.
Alas, our Dark Lady wants to help speed up the process a tad so why not pass these morbid days by spreading a little death and disease across the land?
Here's the plan, friend: you go out to Nethander Stead, south of Tarren Mill and east of the river and Southshore. Collect for me 6 Mudsnout Blossoms from the field for my next elixir.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, the horrible reek of Mudsnout Blossoms. At least those filthy Gnolls are good for something.
